summary: The PR adds four CAM preferences for the ToolBit shape drawing, makes the Chamfer `Diameter` a derived read-only parameter, and makes the shape drawing theme-aware with a highlight link between each dimension and its property field.
intent: A reader can find the new "Tool Bit Shape Drawing" group in the CAM preferences and can set the dimension color for a light theme, the dimension color for a dark theme, the highlight color, and the artwork brightness. `reference/preferences.adoc` tells this, with the defaults and the 10 % to 100 % range of the brightness. A reader also learns that the Chamfer `Diameter` is not an input: FreeCAD calculates it from `TipDiameter`, `CuttingEdgeHeight` and `CuttingEdgeAngle`, the ToolBit editor does not show it, and the property view shows it as read-only. `tools/tool-shape.adoc` tells this. The theme colors and the highlight between a dimension and its field are appearance only, thus `tools/toolbit.adoc` needs only new figures of the ToolBit editor.

pages.reason: Gui/DlgSettingsPathColor.ui: new group box 'Tool Bit Shape Drawing' with ToolBitDimensionColorLight (#111111), ToolBitDimensionColorDark (#23818d), ToolBitDimensionHighlightColor (#ff8c00) and ToolBitArtworkBrightness (85 %, range 10 to 100); Path/Preferences.py adds the four parameter names

Path/Tool/shape/models/chamfer.py: derived_parameters() calculates Diameter = TipDiameter + 2 * CuttingEdgeHeight * tan(CuttingEdgeAngle / 2); toolbit/models/base.py sets editor mode read-only and toolbit/ui/editor.py removes derived parameters from the editor form. This is the part a reader acts on; the theme colors of the drawings are appearance only

Path/Tool/toolbit/ui/editor.py and shape/models/icon.py: the shape drawing in the ToolBit editor has theme colors and a dimension highlight, and the Chamfer editor form does not show Diameter; figures of the editor are now wrong, the text stays correct
Path/Tool/toolbit/ui/tablecell.py: the list icon drops the dimensions (dimensions=False); appearance only and the page does not describe it
Path/Main/Gui/Job.py: theme detection moves to Path/Base/Gui/Theme.py; refactor with no change of behaviour
Gui/DlgSettingsPathColor.ui and Path/Preferences.py: the new preferences are not experimental feature flags; the page does not describe them
